caption: The drawing shows a circular arrangement (wreath) composed of various types of flowers and foliage. The flowers are colored in shades of pink, purple, red, and blue, with yellow centers on some blooms. The petals are intricately detailed, with visible lines and patterns indicating texture. The foliage is mainly green, with leaves of different shapes and sizes interspersed throughout the wreath. The composition is dense, with flowers and leaves closely packed together, forming a continuous ring that leaves an empty circular space in the center. The background is plain and light-colored, without any additional patterns or objects.
title: Cemetary Wreath
